title: Far Field
style: Cinematic fine-art landscape photograph. A vast, quiet place in dramatic natural light, shot on a full-frame camera with a long lens or a fast prime, with very shallow depth of field or deliberate motion blur exactly as described. Rich filmic colour grading, deep soft shadows, glowing highlights, a fine film grain. Portrait framing, the subject composed with generous sky or space. No people unless stated, no signs, no text or lettering anywhere, no logos, no watermark, no border, no frame.

items.title: Wheat at Dusk
items.text: The camera moved and the wheat turned to light.
items.prompt: A field of ripe wheat at dusk, the sun just set behind rolling hills, the camera panning sideways at a slow shutter so the wheat streaks into soft horizontal gold lines while the far hills stay almost sharp, a deep amber and violet sky.

items.title: The Ridge
items.text: One walker on the knife edge of a dune, a kilometre away.
items.prompt: The knife-edge crest of a huge orange sand dune at sunrise, one tiny walker far away on the ridge, a long telephoto lens compressing dune behind dune into soft layers, the foreground sand out of focus, warm low light and long blue shadows.

items.title: Sea Stacks
items.text: A two-second breath of fog around black basalt.
items.prompt: Tall black basalt sea stacks rising out of a pale grey ocean in thick fog, a two-second exposure smoothing the sea into soft mist, cold blue light, the stacks fading into the fog behind.

items.title: Lagoon, Blue Hour
items.text: Icebergs glowing after the sun has gone.
items.prompt: Icebergs floating in a glacier lagoon at blue hour, the deep blue ice glowing from within, a long exposure making the water glassy and still, a thin band of pink on the horizon above dark mountains.

items.title: Heat Road
items.text: The road ends where the air starts to melt.
items.prompt: A straight empty desert road running toward distant mountains that dissolve in heat haze and shimmer, an extremely long lens, the near road out of focus, pale bleached colours and a white sky.

items.title: Meadow
items.text: Wildflowers so close they turn to colour.
items.prompt: An alpine meadow at golden hour with jagged grey peaks behind, the camera low in the grass at f/1.2 so wildflowers in the foreground melt into large soft bokeh of pink, yellow and violet, the peaks softly sharp in warm light.

items.title: Salt Mirror
items.text: A thin film of water doubles the whole sky.
items.prompt: A vast salt flat covered by a thin film of water mirroring a pastel dusk sky with long streaked clouds, the horizon a thin line in the middle, perfectly calm and symmetrical, pink, peach and lavender.

items.title: Black Sand
items.text: Waves pulled into silver silk around the rocks.
items.prompt: A black sand beach with a long exposure of incoming waves turning into silver silk around dark rocks, a heavy stormy sky with a sliver of low sun breaking through on the horizon.

items.title: Pine Fog
items.text: The sun finds the gaps between the trees.
items.prompt: A dark pine forest in morning fog, the low sun breaking through in visible beams of light, the nearest trunks out of focus in the foreground, the far trees fading into luminous white haze.

items.title: Storm Cliffs
items.text: A single shaft of sun on the cliff top.
items.prompt: Towering dark sea cliffs under a breaking storm, a single shaft of sunlight lighting the green cliff top, slanting rain streaks in the air, a churning grey sea far below.

items.title: Lavender Rows
items.text: Rows of lavender running out of the frame.
items.prompt: Rows of lavender at sunset, the camera moving fast along the rows so the purple lines blur into converging streaks, one lone tree on the horizon kept almost sharp against an orange sky.

items.title: White Horses
items.text: Three horses, the spray and the sun all moving.
items.prompt: Three white horses galloping through shallow marsh water at sunrise, the camera panning with them so the horses are nearly sharp while the spray and the background streak into golden motion blur.

items.title: Terraces
items.text: Water fields stepping down into the cloud.
items.prompt: Rice terraces stepping down a mountainside in morning mist, water in the terraces reflecting the pale sky, soft layers of ridges fading into the haze, muted silver, green and rose.

items.title: Red Canyon
items.text: Sandstone glowing from light bounced down its walls.
items.prompt: Inside a narrow red sandstone slot canyon, light bouncing off the smooth curved walls in glowing orange, red and violet, a soft beam from above, very shallow focus on one curve with the rest falling into soft blur.

items.title: Frozen Lake
items.text: Bubbles caught in the ice under a pink peak.
items.prompt: A frozen mountain lake at dawn, cracks and trapped white bubbles in clear dark ice in the foreground out of focus, a pink-lit snowy peak in the distance, a cold blue and rose palette.

items.title: Grass and Moon
items.text: A huge moon behind grass the wind won't let rest.
items.prompt: Tall pampas grass blowing in the wind at dusk with a huge pale full moon rising behind it, a long lens, the grass plumes soft with wind blur, a deep blue sky fading to warm peach at the bottom.

items.title: Volcano Breath
items.text: A smoking cone above a sea of gold mist.
items.prompt: A smoking volcano cone rising above a sea of morning mist, the first sun lighting the mist gold, layered dark ridges behind, a thin plume of smoke drifting sideways.

items.title: Birch Snow
items.text: Falling snow drawn into lines by a slow shutter.
items.prompt: A white birch forest in heavy falling snow, a slow shutter turning the snowflakes into soft diagonal streaks, the trunks fading into white, muted blue, grey and white.

items.title: Tulip Lines
items.text: Stripes of tulips swept into paint.
items.prompt: A tulip field in bold stripes of red, pink and orange under a dramatic cloudy sky, intentional camera movement upward so the stripes blur into painterly vertical lines while the horizon stays readable.

items.title: Night Coast
items.text: The sea turned to mist under the moon.
items.prompt: A rugged coastline at night under bright moonlight, a long exposure turning the sea into pale mist around dark rocks, stars in a deep blue sky, the faint beam of a lighthouse far away on a headland.
